description: Single source of truth for the Levela splash (launch welcome) flow. scripts/verify_splash_parity.sh checks that the Android and iOS Splash features expose the same stages, timings, copy and colours. The splash icon is the app's own launcher icon foreground (no generated asset). Colour names are the primitives declared in assets/theme/theme-contract.json.

icon.note: The app's own launcher icon foreground: Android @drawable/ic_launcher_foreground, iOS AppIcon (dark/alpha appearance). Not generated. Sized per platform (Android 204dp, iOS 96pt).
